forum.title: What happened to the Signing Tool?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@Neuraleanus,

Signing tool is indeed there, there just have been a change starting from STM32CubeProgrammer v2.21. Please refer to this thread: [SigningTool for STM32N6 in STM32CubeProgrammer v2.21.0 | Community](https://community.st.com/stm32cubeprogrammer-mcus-30/signingtool-for-stm32n6-in-stm32cubeprogrammer-v2-21-0-159841?tid=159841&fid=30).

Aziz
forum.content_text: I recently download and installed the latest version of STMCube Programmer and I see that the Signing Tool is now gone.  In its place is the STM32 Trusted Package Creator.  Unfortunately, support for the STM32N6 appears to be missing.  Where may I find the old signing tool?
forum.author: Neuraleanus

scraped_replies.html:
